summary: Configured PostgreSQL 16 streaming replication across the 3-node RHEL 10 cluster: node1 is the writable primary, node2 and node3 are read-only physical standbys connected via dedicated replication slots over async streaming. Verified writes on the primary propagate to both standbys and that standbys reject writes. Completed the mandatory one-at-a-time restart protocol on all three nodes (standbys first, primary last), proving changed boot IDs and full data/replication recovery after each restart.
actions_performed: Installed postgresql-server/contrib 16.14 on node1, node2, node3 (retried a transient GPG-key parse failure on node2)
Initialized the primary database on node1 (postgresql-setup --initdb), enabled and started postgresql
Generated a random replication password on node1 and created role `replicator` with REPLICATION LOGIN

Configured node1 postgresql.conf (listen_addresses='*', wal_level=replica, max_wal_senders=10, max_replication_slots=10, hot_standby=on) and pg_hba.conf to allow scram-sha-256 replication connections from node2/node3
Opened firewalld postgresql service on all three nodes
Set up passwordless inter-node SSH using the cluster keypair and transferred the replication password from node1 to node2/node3 via scp, never printing it to the session
Created two physical replication slots (node2_slot, node3_slot) on the primary
Ran pg_basebackup with -R on node2 and node3 to clone the primary, write standby.signal/primary_conninfo, and bind each to its dedicated slot
Started and enabled PostgreSQL on both standbys, confirmed streaming state and read-only enforcement
Created a test table on the primary, inserted rows, confirmed visibility on both standbys and INSERT rejection on standbys
Captured pre-restart boot_id, replication/service state, and row counts on all three nodes
Restarted node2, then node3, then node1 (primary) one at a time via systemctl reboot, polling each until exec access returned
Verified changed boot_id on each node post-restart, re-enabled postgresql autostart on node2 (was not enabled pre-restart), confirmed data and replication state fully recovered after each restart
Inserted a new row on the primary after its own restart and confirmed it replicated to both standbys

evidence.summary: postgresql-server-16.14 installed successfully on node1, node2 (after retry), node3

evidence.requirement: Primary initialized and configured for streaming replication on node1
evidence.summary: initdb run, replicator role created, postgresql.conf/pg_hba.conf updated for replication, service restarted active with wal_level=replica

evidence.requirement: Standbys built from primary via pg_basebackup with replication slots
evidence.summary: node2_slot/node3_slot created on primary; pg_basebackup completed 100% on node2 and node3 with standby.signal and primary_conninfo present; both standbys started active

evidence.requirement: Standbys are read-only and streaming from primary
evidence.summary: pg_stat_replication shows both walreceivers streaming; INSERT on node2/node3 fails with read-only transaction error, transaction_read_only=on

evidence.requirement: Changes committed on primary are visible on both standbys
evidence.summary: 2 rows inserted on node1 (primary), immediately visible in SELECT * FROM repl_test on both node2 and node3

evidence.requirement: Healthy baseline captured pre-restart for all nodes
evidence.summary: boot_id, postgresql active state, row counts, and replication/recovery state captured on node1, node2, node3 before any restart

evidence.requirement: node2 restart acknowledged, boot identity changed, and recovery verified
evidence.summary: reboot command acknowledged before disconnect; boot_id changed from 6d37896c... to 0c70f365...; postgresql (re-enabled) came back active, in recovery, with repl_test data intact

evidence.requirement: node3 restart acknowledged, boot identity changed, and recovery verified
evidence.summary: reboot command acknowledged before disconnect; boot_id changed from e625b9a5... to a11e4f8e...; postgresql active, in recovery, with repl_test data intact

evidence.requirement: node1 (primary) restart acknowledged, boot identity changed, and recovery verified including resumed replication
evidence.summary: both standbys confirmed streaming before primary restart; reboot acknowledged; boot_id changed from 180a78a0... to 943cd844...; primary came back active, not in recovery, data intact, both standbys reconnected streaming; new post-restart INSERT on primary replicated to both node2 and node3
